Hi Team Grand Monarch Banquets & Event Planners,

I was admiring your event portfolio and venue setups in Delhi NCR.

Data across premier event venues shows that over 65% of high-budget inquiries occur on mobile between 7 PM and 11 PM. When prospective clients can't immediately check date availability or pricing tiers, they submit RFPs to 3 competitor venues.

We build branded WhatsApp booking bots that instantly answer date availability, qualify guest counts/budget tiers, and auto-book venue walk-throughs directly into your calendar.

Would you be open to a 5-minute walkthrough of a live prototype this Wednesday?

Warm regards,
Event Tech & Booking Team
